subject.title: feat(dashboard): Workspaces tab — live grid, built-in widgets, Overview-as-data [2/3]

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-on bundled dashboard/workspaces plugin with this dependency graph change, or require the dashboard to be disabled, externalized, or narrowed before merge?
rationale: The patch adds a broad default-on product surface plus dependency graph changes from an external fork, and that acceptance is a maintainer product/security choice rather than a deterministic code repair.

options.title: Accept After Repair And Approval
options.body: Proceed with the bundled dashboard direction only after the correctness findings are fixed, the branch is rebased, and security/admin approval covers the dependency graph for the exact head.

options.title: Narrow Or Disable By Default
options.body: Keep the dashboard work in core only if it ships behind an explicit enablement path or a smaller non-default surface with upgrade proof.

options.title: Move Outside Core
options.body: Route the dashboard capability to an external plugin/ClawHub track if maintainers do not want a default-on bundled workspace product surface.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repair And Approval
recommendation.body: Proceed with the bundled dashboard direction only after the correctness findings are fixed, the branch is rebased, and security/admin approval covers the dependency graph for the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current-main Control UI plugin-tab seam and adjacent shell ownership history point to this owner as the best available product-direction reviewer.
